underdetermined_behaviors: Entry ordering: format.md does not specify the order in which the map's entries are serialized, so every probe with two or more entries (indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7) admits more than one format-conforming output. reference.py imposes sorted-by-key order, which format.md does not determine; an implementation following format.md's text and emitting entries in insertion order diverges on probes 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 (probes 0 and 2 agree only because their insertion order coincides with sorted order).

Backslash handling in values: format.md mandates escaping only ';' and '=' occurring in a value and says nothing about the escape character '\' itself, so the encoding of any value containing a backslash (probes 3, 4, 7) is undetermined. reference.py additionally doubles backslashes ('\' -> '\\'), which format.md does not require; an implementation escaping exactly the mandated characters diverges on all three of those probes.
